view_frame: Front view (XZ) displays the wheel face with X as horizontal width and Z as vertical height. Right view (YZ) displays the wheel thickness with Y as horizontal depth and Z as vertical height. The wheel is centered at the origin (0,0,0).

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Outer radius 60 mm, inner radius 50 mm (derived from OD 120 and ASSUMED rim_width 10). Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows two concentric circles. Right view shows a rectangle of height 120 and width 8. Text label 'OD 120 mm; thickness 8 mm'.

features.placement: Centered at (0,0,0). Radius 15 mm (derived from ASSUMED hub_diameter 30). Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows a central circle. Right view shows the same thickness as the rim.

features.placement: 8 radial boxes centered at (0,0,0). Each spoke extends from the hub surface (r=15) to the rim inner surface (r=50). Extends from Y=-4 to Y=4.
features.evidence: Front view shows 8 radial lines connecting the hub to the rim. Text label '8 spokes'.

connections: wheel_rim, wheel_hub, and wheel_spokes share the same Y-axis extent (thickness 8 mm)
edit_rules: Changing OD 120 mm updates wheel_rim outer radius and wheel_spokes outer extent.
Changing thickness 8 mm updates the Y-axis extent of all features.
Changing ASSUMED rim_width 10 mm updates wheel_rim inner radius and wheel_spokes inner extent.
Changing ASSUMED hub_diameter 30 mm updates wheel_hub radius and wheel_spokes inner extent.
Changing ASSUMED spoke_width 8 mm updates the width of each spoke box.
unresolved: Rim width is not dimensioned; ASSUMED 10 mm based on visual proportion.
Hub diameter is not dimensioned; ASSUMED 30 mm based on visual proportion.
Spoke width is not dimensioned; ASSUMED 8 mm based on visual proportion.
